question: The person who was instrumental in bringing Mahatma Gandhi to Champaran in 1917 was:
solution:
The correct answer is **Raj Kumar Shukla**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raj Kumar Shukla** was a local farmer from Champaran, Bihar.
 
• He was instrumental in persuading Mahatma Gandhi to visit Champaran to address the grievances of the farmers.
 
• The farmers were oppressed by the British planters who forced them to grow indigo under exploitative conditions.
 
• Gandhi's visit to Champaran in 1917 marked the beginning of the first civil disobedience movement in India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Aruna Asaf Ali was a prominent freedom fighter and is known for hoisting the Indian National Congress flag at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Bombay during the Quit India Movement in 1942.
 
 

 Option 2
 Maulana Mazharul Haque was an Indian independence activist and a prominent leader in the Indian National Congress, but he was not directly involved in bringing Gandhi to Champaran.
 
 

 Option 3
 Raj Kumar Shukla, a local farmer, played a crucial role in bringing Mahatma Gandhi to Champaran to address the plight of the indigo farmers.
 
 

 Option 4
 Batak Miyan was a cook who saved Mahatma Gandhi's life by warning him about a plot to poison him during his Champaran visit.
